snippet.title: Dorts:A Darts Roguelike - Trailer! Brand NEW PC DARTS GAME with Multiplayer and Career Modes! #darts
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4463680/Dorts__A_Darts_Roguelike_Demo

Its only darts. How hard can it be?

DORTS is a first-person darts roguelike. Step up to the oche, draft upgrades, and try to keep it together as the disruptions pile up — reversed controls, spinning boards, shrinking doubles, and a crowd that's had far too many pints.

23 upgrades. 16 disruptions. 12 mutators. 43 opponents. Career mode with a four-division league. Steam multiplayer. Tournament brackets. No microtransactions.
